A regional bakery runs four retail locations and one central production
kitchen. Deliveries currently leave the kitchen whenever a van is loaded, so
some shops receive stock hours before opening and others run out by mid
afternoon. Nobody tracks which products sell out first at which location.

Plan a scheduling overhaul for the delivery runs. Cover how demand per
location per product is measured, how the daily production order is set from
that measurement, the delivery timetable itself, what happens on a day when
production falls short, and how the team will know within one month whether
the change worked.

Produce a plan of roughly 500 words.
